CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.BeastBuddy,onTagAdded,onTagRemoved)"},{"id":494,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ToolHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ToolHelper"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local PickaxeValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.PickaxeValue

function onTagAdded(tool:Tool,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    if not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Pickaxe) then return end

    -- local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
    local nextAttackTime = 0
    table.insert(connections,tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
        if tool.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end

        local v_PickaxeActivatedCD:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(tool,PickaxeValue.PickaxeActivatedCD)
        local v_PickaxeRange:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(tool,PickaxeValue.PickaxeRange)

        local atkTrack:AnimationTrack = nil

        local ActivatedCon = tool.Activated:Connect(function()
            local gameTimeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime
            if gameTimeNow < nextAttackTime then return end
            
            -- 计算CD
            local activatedCD = math.max(v_PickaxeActivatedCD.Value,0.1)
            nextAttackTime = gameTimeNow + activatedCD

            -- 动画
            if not atkTrack then
                local animation:Animation = tool:FindFirstChild("AttackAnimation")
                atkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(LocalPlayer.Character, animation or "rbxassetid://90717545543382") -- 砍动作
                atkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
                atkTrack.Looped = false
                atkTrack:GetMarkerReachedSignal("Hit"):Connect(function(paramString)
                    -- print("触发事件帧",paramString)
                    -- print("触发采掘伤害判定")
                    local op = OverlapParams.new()
                    op:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.PickaxeTarget))
                    op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

                    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(tool:GetPivot().Position,v_PickaxeRange.Value,op)
                    local hitTargets:{BasePart} = {}
                    for _,hit:BasePart in ipairs(hits) do
                        local target = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.PickaxeTarget)
                        if not target then continue end
                        if table.find(hitTargets,target) then continue end
                        table.insert(hitTargets,target)
                    end

                    GameHelper.PickaxeHitC2S:FireServer(hitTargets)
                end)
            end
            atkTrack:Play()
            atkTrack:AdjustSpeed(1/activatedCD) -- 动画速度匹配攻速
        end)

        tool.Unequipped:Once(function()
            if ActivatedCon then
                ActivatedCon:Disconnect()
                ActivatedCon = nil
            end
            if atkTrack then
                atkTrack:Destroy()
                atkTrack = nil
            end
        end)
    end))
end

CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.Pickaxe,onTagAdded)"},{"id":495,"text":"local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))

local _speed = 0.1
local _offset = Vector3.yAxis * 0.5
function onTagAdded(lode:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local v_HP:NumberValue = lode:WaitForChild("HP")
    local originCFrame = lode:GetPivot()

    local t = 0
    table.insert(connections,v_HP.Changed:Connect(function(value)
        if v_HP.Value > 0 then
            -- 跳一下
            t = _speed
        else
            t = 0
            lode:PivotTo(originCFrame)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt:number)
        if t <= 0 then return end

        t -= dt
        if t < 0 then t = 0 end
        local scale = t / _speed
        local rate = math.sin(scale * math.pi)
        lode:PivotTo(originCFrame - _offset * rate)
    end))
end

CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.Lode,onTagAdded)"},{"id":496,"text":"local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local AudioHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local visualEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("NPCGunVisualS2C")

local function getWorldPosition(instance)
	if not instance then
		return nil
	end
	if instance:IsA("Attachment") then
		return instance.WorldPosition
	end
	if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		return instance.Position
	end
	return nil
end

local function findMuzzle(source)
	local tool = source and source:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
	if tool then
		local firePoint = tool:FindFirstChild("FirePoint", true)
		local position = getWorldPosition(firePoint)
		if position then
			return position, firePoint
		end
	end
	local head = source and source:FindFirstChild("Head")
	return head and head.Position, head
end

visualEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(source, target)
	if not source or not target or not source:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return
	end
	local fromPosition, soundParent = findMuzzle(source)
	local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.PrimaryPart
	local toPosition = targetRoot and targetRoot.Position
	if not fromPosition or not toPosition then
		return
	end
	local distance = (toPosition - fromPosition).Magnitude
	if distance <= 0.1 or distance > 500 then
		return
	end

	local tracer = Instance.new("Part")
	tracer.Name = "OldCowboyBulletVisual"
	tracer.Anchored = true
	tracer.CanCollide = false
	tracer.CanQuery = false
	tracer.CanTouch = false
	tracer.CastShadow = false
	tracer.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	tracer.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 213, 92)
	tracer.Size = Vector3.new(0.07, 0.07, distance)
	tracer.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((fromPosition + toPosition) / 2, toPosition)
	tracer.Parent = workspace

	TweenService:Create(tracer, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
		Transparency = 1,
		Size = Vector3.new(0.02, 0.02, distance),
	}):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(tracer, 0.15)
	pcall(function()
		AudioHelper:PlayEffect("敌人手枪射击", soundParent, {
            SourceKey = source,
            TargetUserId = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target).UserId or nil,
            FallbackPosition = fromPosition,
        })
	end)
end)"},{"id":497,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local CommonEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("CommonEnum"))
local CommonType = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("CommonType"))
local MapHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("MapHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local UIHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("UIHelper"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))

local CampfireValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.CampfireValue
local GroundValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.GroundValue

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local _explored:{{boolean}} = {} -- 已经探索过的
local _buildings:{Model} = {}
local _uiMapPoints:{{GuiObject}} = {} -- key:坐标字符串 value:UIMapPoint
local _unlockTreasure:{Model} = {}
local _treasureGuis:{{Model}} = {}
local _horseGuis:{{Model}} = {}
local _trainGuis:{{Model}} = {}
local _markersByUserId:{[number]:CommonType.MapMarkerVo} = {}
local _markerGuis:{[GuiObject]:{[number]:GuiObject}} = {}
local _markerPortraits:{[number]:string} = {}
local _gearSourceGuis:{[GuiObject]:{[Model]:GuiObject}} = {}
local GearSourceMarkerTag = "GearSourceMarker"
local GearSourceStateColors = {
    Guarded = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 70),
    InTransit = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 70),
    Installed = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 120),
}
local fogSize = 1/MapHelper.mapSize_1

local Tag_UIMap = "UIMap"
local Fog_Z = 30
local MarkerTipMouse = "Click map to place. Click your marker to remove."
local MarkerTipTouch = "Tap map to place. Tap your marker to remove."

local _prefabsFolder:Frame = game.StarterGui:WaitForChild("UIMap"):WaitForChild("RootFrame"):WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("prefabs")
for _,iconPrefab:GuiObject in ipairs(_prefabsFolder:GetChildren()) do
    if iconPrefab:IsA("GuiObject") then
        iconPrefab.Visible = false
    end
end

function onMarkerSnapshot(markers:{CommonType.MapMarkerVo})
    table.clear(_markersByUserId)
    for _,markerVo:CommonType.MapMarkerVo in ipairs(markers) do
        _markersByUserId[markerVo.userId] = markerVo
    end
    syncAllMapMarkers()
    updateWorldMarkerBillboards()
end

function onMarkerUpsert(markerVo:CommonType.MapMarkerVo)
    _markersByUserId[markerVo.userId] = markerVo
    syncAllMapMarkers()
    updateWorldMarkerBillboard(markerVo.userId,markerVo)
end

function onMarkerRemove(userId:number)
    _markersByUserId[userId] = nil
    setWorldMarkerBillboardVisible(userId,false)
    for map:GuiObject,_ in pairs(_markerGuis) do
        removeMarkerGuiByUserId(map,userId)
    end
end

function init()
    for grid1X=MapHelper.centerGrid1-5,MapHelper.centerGrid1+5 do
        for grid1Z=MapHelper.centerGrid1-5,MapHelper.centerGrid1+5 do
            setIsFog(grid1X,grid1Z,false)
            setFogUI(grid1X,grid1Z,false)
        end
    end
end

function worldPosToMapPos(position:Vector3)
    local pos = position + (MapHelper.mapSize_1 / 2 * MapHelper.gridSize_1) * CommonEnum.XZ
    local scaleX = pos.X / MapHelper.mapSize
    local scaleZ = pos.Z / MapHelper.mapSize
    return UDim2.fromScale(scaleX,scaleZ)
end

function getMarkerGuiMap(map:GuiObject)
    local markerGuis = _markerGuis[map]
    if not markerGuis then
        markerGuis = {}
        _markerGuis[map] = markerGuis
    end
    return markerGuis
end

function getMarkerDistanceText(position:Vector3)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return "--m" end
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return "--m" end
    return string.format("%dm",math.round((humanoidRootPart.Position - position).Magnitude))
end

function getWorldMarkerModel(userId:number)
    local markerFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("MapMarkers")
    if not markerFolder then return end
    return markerFolder:FindFirstChild(string.format("MapMarker_%d",userId))
end

function getWorldMarkerBillboard(userId:number)
    local markerModel:Model = getWorldMarkerModel(userId)
    if not markerModel then return end

    local root = markerModel:FindFirstChild("Root")
    if root then
        return root:FindFirstChild("BillboardGui")
    end

    return markerModel:FindFirstChild("BillboardGui",true)
end

function setWorldMarkerBillboardVisible(userId:number,isVisible:boolean)
    local billboard:BillboardGui = getWorldMarkerBillboard(userId)
    if billboard then
        billboard.Enabled = isVisible
    end
end

function updateWorldMarkerBillboard(userId:number,markerVo:CommonType.MapMarkerVo)
    local billboard:BillboardGui = getWorldMarkerBillboard(userId)
    if not billboard then return end

    billboard.Enabled = true

    local t_name:TextLabel = billboard:FindFirstChild("t_name")
    local t_distance:TextLabel = billboard:FindFirstChild("t_distance")
    if t_name then
        t_name.Text = markerVo.nickname
    end
    if t_distance then
        t_distance.Text = getMarkerDistanceText(markerVo.position)
    end
end

function updateWorldMarkerBillboards()
    for userId,markerVo:CommonType.MapMarkerVo in pairs(_markersByUserId) do
        updateWorldMarkerBillboard(userId,markerVo)
    end
end

function updateMarkerPortrait(userId:number,img_icon:ImageLabel)
    local portrait = _markerPortraits[userId]
    if portrait then
        img_icon.Image = portrait
        return
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local content, isReady = game.Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(userId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size48x48)
        if not isReady then return end
        _markerPortraits[userId] = content
        if img_icon and img_icon.Parent then
            img_icon.Image = content
        end
    end)
end

function removeMarkerGuiByUserId(map:GuiObject,userId:number)
    local markerGuis = _markerGuis[map]
    if not markerGuis then return end

    local markerGui = markerGuis[userId]
    if markerGui then
        markerGui:Destroy()
        markerGuis[userId] = nil
    end
end

function upsertMarkerGui(map:GuiObject,markerVo:CommonType.MapMarkerVo)
    local prefab:GuiObject = findPrefab("MapMarker")
    if not prefab then return end

    local markerGuis = getMarkerGuiMap(map)
    local markerGui:ImageButton = markerGuis[markerVo.userId]
    if not markerGui then
        markerGui = prefab:Clone()
        markerGui.Visible = true
        markerGui.Parent = map
        markerGuis[markerVo.userId] = markerGui

        local markerUserId = markerVo.userId
        markerGui.Activated:Connect(function()
            if markerUserId == LocalPlayer.UserId then
                GameHelper.RemoveMapMarkerC2S:FireServer()
            end
        end)
    end

    markerGui.Position = worldPosToMapPos(markerVo.position)
    markerGui.ZIndex = Fog_Z + 40
    markerGui:SetAttribute("userId",markerVo.userId)

    local img_icon:ImageLabel = markerGui:FindFirstChild("img_icon")
    local t_name:TextLabel = markerGui:FindFirstChild("t_name")
    local t_distance:TextLabel = markerGui:FindFirstChild("t_distance")
    if img_icon then
        img_icon.ZIndex = markerGui.ZIndex + 1
        updateMarkerPortrait(markerVo.userId,img_icon)
    end
    if t_name then
        t_name.ZIndex = markerGui.ZIndex + 2
        t_name.Text = markerVo.nickname
    end
    if t_distance then
        t_distance.ZIndex = markerGui.ZIndex + 2
        t_distance.Text = getMarkerDistanceText(markerVo.position)
    end

    if markerVo.userId == LocalPlayer.UserId then
        markerGui.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,232,160)
    else
        markerGui.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    end
end

function syncMapMarkers(map:GuiObject)
    local markerGuis = getMarkerGuiMap(map)
    for userId,_ in pairs(markerGuis) do
        if not _markersByUserId[userId] then
            removeMarkerGuiByUserId(map,userId)
        end
    end

    for _,markerVo:CommonType.MapMarkerVo in pairs(_markersByUserId) do
        upsertMarkerGui(map,markerVo)
    end
end

function syncAllMapMarkers()
    local maps = CollectionService:GetTagged(Tag_UIMap)
    for _,map:GuiObject in ipairs(maps) do
        syncMapMarkers(map)
    end
end

function canPlaceMarkerAtWorldPos(worldPos:Vector3,campfireLevel:number,campfireHeat:number)
    if campfireHeat <= 0 then
        return false,"Reignite the campfire to place a marker."
    end

    local grid1X,grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(worldPos)
    if not MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) then
        return false
    end
    if MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) > campfireLevel then
        return false,"You can't place a marker in a locked area."
    end

    return true
end

function onMarkerMapInput(map:GuiObject,v_heat:NumberValue,v_level:NumberValue,input:InputObject)
    if input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end

    local absolutePosition = map.AbsolutePosition
    local absoluteSize = map.AbsoluteSize
    if absoluteSize.X <= 0 or absoluteSize.Y <= 0 then return end

    local scaleX = (input.Position.X - absolutePosition.X) / absoluteSize.X
    local scaleZ = (input.Position.Y - absolutePosition.Y) / absoluteSize.Y
    if scaleX < 0 or scaleX > 1 or scaleZ < 0 or scaleZ > 1 then return end

    local worldPos = MapHelper:MapScaleToWorldPos(scaleX,scaleZ)
    local canPlace,tips = canPlaceMarkerAtWorldPos(worldPos,v_level.Value,v_heat.Value)
    if not canPlace then
        if tips then
            UIHelper:PopCenterTips(tips,UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
        end
        return
    end

    GameHelper.PlaceMapMarkerC2S:FireServer(Vector2.new(scaleX,scaleZ))
end

function updateMarkerDistances(map:GuiObject)
    local markerGuis = _markerGuis[map]
    if not markerGuis then return end

    for userId,markerGui:GuiObject in pairs(markerGuis) do
        local markerVo = _markersByUserId[userId]
        local t_distance:TextLabel = markerGui:FindFirstChild("t_distance")
        if markerVo and t_distance then
            t_distance.Text = getMarkerDistanceText(markerVo.position)
        end
    end
end

function getIsFog(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number)
    if not GameHelper.FogEnable then return false end
    local isFog
    if _explored[grid1X] then
        isFog = _explored[grid1X][grid1Z]
    end
    if isFog == nil then
        isFog = true
    end
    return isFog
end

function setIsFog(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number,isFog)
    -- 已经探索过的格子
    if not _explored[grid1X] then _explored[grid1X] = {} end
    _explored[grid1X][grid1Z] = isFog
end

function onClearFog(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number)
    local isFog = getIsFog(grid1X,grid1Z)
    if not isFog then return end

    setIsFog(grid1X,grid1Z,false)
    local r = 2
    for x=grid1X-r,grid1X+r do
        for z=grid1Z-r,grid1Z+r do
            setFogUI(x,z,false)
        end
    end
end

function setFogUIByMap(map:Frame,grid1X:number,grid1Z:number,isFog:boolean)
    local parent:Folder = map:FindFirstChild("迷雾")
    if not parent then
        parent = Instance.new("Folder")
        parent.Name = "迷雾"
        parent.Parent = map
    end
    local name = string.format("%d,%d",grid1X,grid1Z)
    local fog:Frame = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
    if isFog then
        if not fog then
            fog = Instance.new("Frame")
            fog.Name = name
            fog.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(146, 140, 121)
            fog.BorderSizePixel = 0
            fog.Size = UDim2.fromScale(fogSize,fogSize)
            fog.Position = UDim2.fromScale((grid1X-1) * fogSize,(grid1Z-1) * fogSize)
            fog.ZIndex = Fog_Z
            fog.Parent = parent
        end
    else
        if fog then
            fog:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

function updateLockFog(map:Frame)
    local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    local v_level:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(campfire,CampfireValue.level)

    local parent:Folder = map:FindFirstChild("禁区")
    if not parent then
        parent = Instance.new("Folder")
        parent.Name = "禁区"
        parent.Parent = map
    end
    local ZIndex = Fog_Z + 30
    local offset = 1
    for grid1X = 1-offset,MapHelper.mapSize_1 + offset do
        for grid1Z = 1-offset,MapHelper.mapSize_1 + offset do
            local name = string.format("%d,%d",grid1X,grid1Z)
            local lockFog:Frame = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
            local isLock = true
            if grid1X >= 1 and grid1X <= MapHelper.mapSize_1 and grid1Z >=1 and grid1Z <= MapHelper.mapSize_1 then
                isLock = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) > v_level.Value
            end

            if isLock then
                if not lockFog then
                    lockFog = Instance.new("Frame")
                    lockFog.Name = name
                    lockFog.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(27, 27, 27)
                    lockFog.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    lockFog.Size = UDim2.fromScale(fogSize,fogSize)
                    lockFog.Position = UDim2.fromScale((grid1X-1) * fogSize,(grid1Z-1) * fogSize)
                    lockFog.ZIndex = ZIndex
                    lockFog.Parent = parent
                end
            else
                if lockFog then
                    lockFog:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function setFogUI(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number,isFog:boolean)
    if grid1X <= 0 or grid1X > MapHelper.mapSize_1 then return end
    if grid1Z <= 0 or grid1Z > MapHelper.mapSize_1 then return end

    local maps = CollectionService:GetTagged(Tag_UIMap)
    for _,map:Frame in ipairs(maps) do
        setFogUIByMap(map,grid1X,grid1Z,isFog)
    end

    -- 雾霾被清理时，置顶图标
    if not isFog then
        local gridName = string.format("%d,%d",grid1X,grid1Z)
        if _uiMapPoints[gridName] then
            for _,mapPoint:GuiObject in ipairs(_uiMapPoints[gridName]) do
                mapPoint.ZIndex += Fog_Z
                -- print("置顶图标")
            end
            table.clear(_uiMapPoints[gridName])
        end
    end
end

function tryGetPrefabByTargetTag(ins:Model)
    local prefabs = _prefabsFolder:GetChildren()
    for _,prefab:GuiObject in ipairs(prefabs) do
        if ins:HasTag(prefab.Name) then
            return prefab

function drawMapPoint(map:Frame,ins:Model)
    local grid1X,grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(ins:GetPivot().Position)
    local gridName = string.format("%d,%d",grid1X,grid1Z)

    if not _uiMapPoints[gridName] then
        _uiMapPoints[gridName] = {}
    end

    local prefab:GuiObject = tryGetPrefabByTargetTag(ins)
    -- if ins:HasTag("UIBuilding") then
    --     prefabName = "building"
    -- elseif ins:HasTag("UITreasure") then
    --     prefabName = "treasure"
    -- elseif ins:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Stronghold) then
    --     prefabName = "wantedman"
    -- elseif ins:HasTag("UIGemTower") then
    --     prefabName = "gemtower"
    -- else
        
    -- end
    if not prefab then return end
    local position:Vector3 = ins:GetPivot().Position
    -- print(prefabName)
    local mapPoint:GuiObject = prefab:Clone()
    mapPoint.Position = worldPosToMapPos(position)
    mapPoint.Visible = true
    mapPoint.Parent = map

    table.insert(_uiMapPoints[gridName],mapPoint)

    if ins:HasTag("UITreasure") then
        if not _treasureGuis[map] then _treasureGuis[map] = {} end
        _treasureGuis[map][ins] = mapPoint

        checkTickTreasure(map,ins)
    elseif ins:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Horse) then
        if not _horseGuis[map] then _horseGuis[map] = {} end
        _horseGuis[map][ins] = mapPoint
    elseif ins:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Train) then
        if not _trainGuis[map] then _trainGuis[map] = {} end

        local dir = ins:GetPivot().LookVector
        local angle = math.atan2(dir.Z, dir.X)
        -- 转换为角度（0-360度）
        local degrees = math.deg(angle)
        local img_dir:ImageLabel = mapPoint:FindFirstChild("img_dir")
        img_dir.Visible = true
        img_dir.Rotation = degrees
        _trainGuis[map][ins] = mapPoint
    end
end

function getGearSourceGuiMap(map:GuiObject)
    local sourceGuis = _gearSourceGuis[map]
    if not sourceGuis then
        sourceGuis = {}
        _gearSourceGuis[map] = sourceGuis
    end
    return sourceGuis
end

function removeGearSourceGui(map:GuiObject, marker:Model)
    local sourceGuis = _gearSourceGuis[map]
    if not sourceGuis then return end
    local gui = sourceGuis[marker]
    if gui then
        gui:Destroy()
        sourceGuis[marker] = nil
    end
end

function syncGearSourceGui(map:GuiObject, marker:Model)
    local sourceGuis = getGearSourceGuiMap(map)
    local gui = sourceGuis[marker]
    if not gui then
        local prefab = findPrefab("GearSource")
        if not prefab then return end
        gui = prefab:Clone()
        gui.Name = "GearSource_" .. tostring(marker:GetAttribute("GearSourceId") or marker.Name)
        gui.Parent = map
        sourceGuis[marker] = gui
    end

    if not marker.Parent then
        removeGearSourceGui(map, marker)
        return
    end

    gui.Position = worldPosToMapPos(marker:GetPivot().Position)
    gui.ZIndex = Fog_Z + 45
    gui.Visible = marker:GetAttribute("GearSourceVisible") == true

    local state = marker:GetAttribute("GearSourceState") or "Guarded"
    local color = GearSourceStateColors[state] or GearSourceStateColors.Guarded
    if gui:IsA("ImageLabel") or gui:IsA("ImageButton") then
        gui.ImageColor3 = color
    end
end

function syncGearSourcePoints(map:GuiObject)
    local sourceGuis = getGearSourceGuiMap(map)
    for marker, _ in pairs(sourceGuis) do
        if not marker.Parent then
            removeGearSourceGui(map, marker)
        end
    end

    for _, marker in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GearSourceMarkerTag)) do
        syncGearSourceGui(map, marker)
    end
end

    local playerPointPrefab:ImageLabel = findPrefab("playerPointPrefab")
    local Empty:Frame = map:WaitForChild("Empty")
    local campfireGui:ImageLabel = map:WaitForChild("campfire")

    local nextStepTime = 0

    for _,building:Model in ipairs(_buildings) do
        drawMapPoint(map,building)

    updateLockFog(map)
    table.insert(connections,v_level.Changed:Connect(function()

    table.insert(connections,v_heat.Changed:Connect(function(value)
        Empty.Visible = v_heat.Value <= 0

    table.insert(connections,clickCatcher.InputBegan:Connect(function(input:InputObject)
        onMarkerMapInput(map,v_heat,v_level,input)
    end))
    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
        if workspace.DistributedGameTime >= nextStepTime then
            nextStepTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 0.5
            for _,player:Player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local playerPoint = playerPoints[player]
                if not playerPoint then
                    playerPoint = playerPointPrefab:Clone()
                    playerPoint.Visible = true
                    playerPoint.Parent = map
                    playerPoints[player] = playerPoint

                    if player == LocalPlayer then
                        playerPoint.ZIndex = 99
                    else
                        playerPoint.ZIndex += Fog_Z
                    end

                    local img_icon:ImageLabel = playerPoint:WaitForChild("img_icon")
                    local img_dir:ImageLabel = playerPoint:WaitForChild("img_dir")
                    local t_name:TextLabel = playerPoint:WaitForChild("t_name")
                    img_dir.Visible = player == LocalPlayer
                    t_name.Text = player.DisplayName
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local content, isReady = game.Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(player.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size48x48)
                        if isReady then
                            img_icon.Image = content
                        end
                    end)

                local character = player.Character
                if not character then continue end
                local cframe = character:GetPivot()
                playerPoint.Position = worldPosToMapPos(cframe.Position)
                local grid1X,grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(cframe.Position)
                onClearFog(grid1X,grid1Z)
            end

            local horses = _horseGuis[map]
            if horses then
                for horse:Model,gui:GuiObject in pairs(horses) do
                    local position:Vector3 = horse:GetPivot().Position
                    gui.Position = worldPosToMapPos(position)
                end
            end

            local trains = _trainGuis[map]
            if trains then
                for train:Model,gui:GuiObject in pairs(trains) do
                    if train:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
                        local position:Vector3 = train:GetPivot().Position
                        gui.Position = worldPosToMapPos(position)
                    else
                        gui:Destroy()
                        trains[train] = nil
                    end
                end
            end

            syncGearSourcePoints(map)
            if map.Parent.Visible then
                updateMarkerDistances(map)
            end
        end

        local myPlayerPoint = playerPoints[LocalPlayer]
        if myPlayerPoint and map.Parent.Visible and not Empty.Visible then
            local dir = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
            local angle = math.atan2(dir.Z, dir.X)
            local degrees = math.deg(angle)
            local img_dir:ImageLabel = myPlayerPoint:WaitForChild("img_dir")
            img_dir.Rotation = degrees
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections,game.Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
        local playerPoint = playerPoints[player]
        if playerPoint then
            playerPoint:Destroy()
        end
        playerPoints[player] = nil
        removeMarkerGuiByUserId(map,player.UserId)
    end))
end

local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local MeleeWeaponSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("MeleeWeaponSetting"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local MeleeCombatClient = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("MeleeCombatClient"))

local swingSounds = {"近战武器Swing1", "近战武器Swing2"}
local newMeleeSwitch = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版近战判定")

local function getEnemyRoot(enemy: Model): BasePart?
    return enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or enemy.PrimaryPart
end

local function isValidAutoFaceEnemy(enemy: Model)
    if not enemy or not enemy:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
    if enemy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyDeath) then return false end

    local humanoid: Humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end

    return getEnemyRoot(enemy) ~= nil
end

local function findNearestEnemy(character: Model, humanoidRootPart: BasePart, searchRange: number): Model?
    local nearestEnemy: Model? = nil
    local nearestDistanceSquared = searchRange * searchRange
    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlapParams.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer
    overlapParams.MaxParts = 128

    debug.profilebegin("Melee.LegacyAutoFace.Query")
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(
        humanoidRootPart.Position,
        math.min(searchRange, 25),
        overlapParams
    )
    debug.profileend()

    local seen = {}
    for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
        local taggedEnemy = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(part, GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
        local enemy = taggedEnemy and (taggedEnemy:IsA("Model") and taggedEnemy or CommonFunc:GetModel(taggedEnemy)) or nil
        if enemy
            and not seen[enemy]
            and enemy ~= character
            and isValidAutoFaceEnemy(enemy) then
            seen[enemy] = true
            local enemyRoot = getEnemyRoot(enemy)
            local offset = enemyRoot.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position
            local distanceSquared = offset:Dot(offset)
            if distanceSquared <= nearestDistanceSquared then
                nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                nearestEnemy = enemy
            end
        end
    end

    return nearestEnemy
end

local function faceEnemy(character: Model, humanoidRootPart: BasePart, enemy: Model)
    local humanoid: Humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Sit then return end

    local enemyRoot = getEnemyRoot(enemy)
    if not enemyRoot then return end

    local rootPos = humanoidRootPart.Position
    local enemyPos = enemyRoot.Position
    local flatTarget = Vector3.new(enemyPos.X, rootPos.Y, enemyPos.Z)
    if (flatTarget - rootPos).Magnitude <= 0.1 then return end

    humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPos, flatTarget)
end

local function startAutoFaceNearestEnemy(character: Model, searchRange: number)
    if newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
    local humanoidRootPart: BasePart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return end

    local autoFaceSwitch: BoolValue = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("近战自动朝向")
    if not autoFaceSwitch.Value then return end

    -- Query once at swing start, then keep following the locked target.
    -- This preserves the original 0.35s turn feel without repeatedly scanning
    -- every enemy while the player is moving.
    local enemy = findNearestEnemy(character, humanoidRootPart, searchRange)
    if not enemy then return end

    local faceEndTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 0.35
    task.spawn(function()
        while not newMeleeSwitch.Value
            and character == game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
            and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
            and workspace.DistributedGameTime <= faceEndTime do
            if not autoFaceSwitch.Value or not isValidAutoFaceEnemy(enemy) then return end

            faceEnemy(character, humanoidRootPart, enemy)
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end

local function onTagAdded(tool: Tool, connections: {RBXScriptConnection})
    local atkTrack: AnimationTrack?
    local range = GameHelper.SwordAtkDistance
    local atkCD = GameHelper.SwordAtkCD
    local v_range: NumberValue = tool:FindFirstChild("Range")
    local v_AtkCD: NumberValue = tool:FindFirstChild("AtkCD")
    -- Known melee prefabs carry the synchronized Range value. Avoid a cold
    -- ResourcesItemHelper lookup during the first tool registration; only
    -- resolve the shared profile when a tool has no compatible Range fallback.
    local meleeProfile = if v_range then nil else MeleeWeaponSetting.GetByTool(tool)
    if v_range then
        range = v_range.Value
    elseif meleeProfile and meleeProfile.reach then
        range = meleeProfile.reach
    end
    if v_AtkCD then atkCD = v_AtkCD.Value end

    table.insert(connections, tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
        local character: Model = tool.Parent
        if character ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then return end
        MeleeCombatClient.RefreshCooldown(tool)
        local animation: Animation = tool:FindFirstChild("AttackAnimation")
        atkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character, animation or "rbxassetid://104248433730006")
        if atkTrack then
            atkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
            atkTrack.Looped = false
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections, tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
        if atkTrack then
            atkTrack:Stop()
            atkTrack:Destroy()
            atkTrack = nil
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections, tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        if newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
        local character: Model = tool.Parent
        if character ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then return end
        if not MeleeCombatClient.TryBeginCooldown(tool, atkCD) then return end

        startAutoFaceNearestEnemy(character, math.clamp(range + 10, 12, 25))

        if atkTrack then
            atkTrack:Play()
            local speed = 2 * GameHelper.SwordAtkCD / atkCD
            atkTrack:AdjustSpeed(speed)
        end

        AudioHelper:PlayEffect(swingSounds[math.random(1, #swingSounds)], tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"), {
            SourceUserId = game.Players.LocalPlayer.UserId,
            SourceKey = "melee-legacy:" .. tool.Name,
        })

        task.wait(0.2)
        if newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end

        local humanoidRootPart: Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoidRootPart then return end

        local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
        overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
        overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        overlapParams.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer
        local cframe = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
        local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(cframe.Position, range, overlapParams)
        local hitModels: {Model} = {}
        local hitEnemy = false
        local hitTree = false

        for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
            local model = CommonFunc:GetModel(part)
            if not model or table.find(hitModels, model) then continue end
            table.insert(hitModels, model)

            if GameHelper:IsNPC(model) then
                if character == game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character and not newMeleeSwitch.Value then
                    GameHelper.CharacterHitTargetC2S:FireServer(model)
                end
                hitEnemy = true
            elseif model:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Tree) or model:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BigTree) then
                hitTree = true
            end
        end

        if hitEnemy then
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("近战武器Hit1", tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"))
        elseif hitTree then
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("砍树", tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"))
        end
    end))
end

    local humanoid:Humanoid = npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")

    CanvasGroup.GroupTransparency = alwaysVisible and 0 or 1
    local hideTween = TweenService:Create(CanvasGroup,tweenInfo,{
        GroupTransparency = 1

    local onHealthChanged = function()

local function onOldCowboyTagAdded(npc:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local humanoidRootPart = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    local hpBillboard = humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("HP")
    if not humanoid or not hpBillboard or not hpBillboard:IsA("BillboardGui") then
        warn("Old Cowboy is missing its authored HumanoidRootPart.HP BillboardGui")
        return
    end

    local canvasGroup = hpBillboard:FindFirstChild("CanvasGroup")
    local bg = canvasGroup and canvasGroup:FindFirstChild("Bg")
    local slide = bg and bg:FindFirstChild("Slide")
    local healthText = canvasGroup and canvasGroup:FindFirstChild("t_health")
    if not canvasGroup or not canvasGroup:IsA("CanvasGroup")
        or not slide or not slide:IsA("GuiObject")
        or not healthText or not healthText:IsA("TextLabel") then
        warn("Old Cowboy authored HP BillboardGui has an invalid hierarchy")
        hpBillboard.Enabled = false
        return
    end

    local function updateHealth()
        if not humanoid.Parent or not hpBillboard.Parent then
            return
        end
        local maxHealth = math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth,1)
        local health = math.clamp(humanoid.Health,0,maxHealth)
        hpBillboard.Enabled = true
        canvasGroup.GroupTransparency = 0
        slide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(health / maxHealth,slide.Size.Y.Scale)
        healthText.Text = string.format("%d/%d",math.floor(health + 0.5),math.floor(maxHealth + 0.5))

local function getFireOrigin(gun:Tool)
    local firePoint = gun and gun:FindFirstChild("FirePoint", true)
    if firePoint and firePoint:IsA("Attachment") then
        return firePoint.WorldPosition
    end
    if firePoint and firePoint:IsA("BasePart") then
        return firePoint.Position
    end
    local handle = gun and gun:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    return handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") and handle.Position
end

    if distance <= 0.01 then return end

    local tracer = Instance.new("Part")
    tracer.Name = "SteamWeaponTracer"
    tracer.Anchored = true
    tracer.CanCollide = false
    tracer.CanQuery = false
    tracer.CanTouch = false
    tracer.CastShadow = false
    tracer.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    tracer.Color = color
    tracer.Transparency = 0.15
    tracer.Size = Vector3.new(width, width, distance)
    tracer.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, endPosition) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -distance / 2)
    tracer.Parent = workspace

    TweenService:Create(tracer, TweenInfo.new(lifetime), {

        Size = Vector3.new(width * 0.25, width * 0.25, distance),

    Debris:AddItem(tracer, lifetime + 0.05)
end
